aboutGame.title: What is Plan B: Terraform?
paragraphs: Plan B: Terraform is a sci-fi automation and city-building game developed by Florian van Strien. You land on a frozen, barren planet, extract and refine its raw resources, and deliver goods to growing cities across a hexagonal grid.

Population growth unlocks new technology, from trucks and depots to rail networks and atmospheric heaters. Your goal is to warm the planet, melt the ice into oceans, seed forests, and build a breathable biosphere for a thriving civilization.

modules.name: Plan B Terraform Beginner Guide
modules.description: A complete beginner walkthrough covering your first landing, resource extraction, city growth, transport setup, and terraforming progression.

highlights.detail: Scan the map and land near iron, sulfur, and carbon so your first truck routes stay short.
Build extractors, smelters, and assemblers to produce iron ingots, concrete, and mechanical parts.
Place depots as buffers so assemblers keep running while transport lines catch up.
Deliver water, concrete, and food to your first city to grow the population past 500.
Unlock rail, then start greenhouse gas production to warm the planet above freezing.

modules.name: Plan B Terraform Tech Tree Guide
modules.description: Understand the population-driven tech tree, unlock priorities, and the progression path from a landing outpost to a planetary biosphere.

highlights.label: Outpost
highlights.detail: 0-100 residents: basic extractors, trucks, and depots.

highlights.label: Settlement
highlights.detail: 500 residents: assembly plants, oxygen supply, and high-capacity depots.

highlights.label: Town
highlights.detail: 2,000 residents: rail tracks, cargo trains, and pumping stations.

highlights.label: City
highlights.detail: 10,000 residents: high-speed trains, highways, and polymer production.

highlights.label: Metropolis
highlights.detail: 50,000 residents: atmospheric heating plants and drone hubs.

highlights.label: Biosphere
highlights.detail: 100,000+ residents: forester stations and planetary geo-engines.

modules.name: Plan B Terraform Production Guide
modules.description: Cover factory chains, resource processing, supply management, and production optimization strategies for expanding cities.

highlights.label: Iron Ingot
highlights.detail: Smelted from iron ore; the base material for steel, rails, and mechanical parts.

highlights.label: Concrete
highlights.detail: Made from sulfur and carbon for city blocks, depots, and factory foundations.

highlights.label: Steel
highlights.detail: Refined from iron ingots for train engines, rails, and reinforced frames.

highlights.label: Polymer
highlights.detail: Carbon plus water or ice; feeds electronics and atmospheric equipment.

highlights.label: Mechanical Parts
highlights.detail: Assembled from iron ingots to build extractors, trucks, and assembly lines.

modules.name: Plan B Terraform Terraforming Guide
modules.description: Explain climate manipulation, temperature control, water formation, vegetation growth, and ecosystem development.

highlights.detail: Build greenhouse gas factories and vent fluorinated gas to raise the global temperature to 0 C.
Melt polar ice and route the runoff into basins to form lakes, rivers, and oceans.
Distribute compost and tree seeds to establish the first vegetation and stabilize soil.
Expand forests so plants convert carbon dioxide into breathable oxygen.
Reach full atmospheric balance and move your population out of sealed domes.

modules.name: Plan B Terraform Tips and Tricks
modules.description: Practical gameplay advice on transport optimization, city expansion, resource planning, and common mistakes to avoid.

highlights.label: Depots
highlights.detail: Chain depots between factories and transport stops to keep every assembler fed.

highlights.label: One-Way
highlights.detail: Build circular one-way delivery loops to prevent vehicle deadlocks at city gates.

highlights.label: Buffers

highlights.label: Pacing
highlights.detail: Do not outpace your delivery routes; stalled cities freeze tech progression.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Plan B Terraform.

items.question: What is Plan B Terraform?
items.answer: Plan B Terraform is a sci-fi automation and city-building game where you terraform a frozen planet. You extract and refine resources, grow cities, and warm the atmosphere until liquid water and forests can sustain a thriving population.

items.question: Is Plan B Terraform free to play?
items.answer: No. Plan B Terraform is a paid PC title sold on Steam with a one-time purchase, so there are no subscriptions or paid codes.

items.question: How do you start in Plan B Terraform?
items.answer: Land near iron, sulfur, and carbon, build extractors and assemblers, and deliver basic goods to your first city. Population growth then unlocks the tech tree.

items.question: How do you terraform a planet in Plan B Terraform?
items.answer: Raise the global temperature with greenhouse gases, melt the ice into oceans, spread tree seeds to build biomass, and let forests convert carbon dioxide into oxygen.

items.question: Which planet or seed should beginners pick in Plan B Terraform?
items.answer: Choose a seed where iron, sulfur, and aluminum sit close to a flat settlement site, so your first truck routes stay short and cheap.
